description: Every BCA registered contractor (data.gov.sg snapshot dated 12 Jan 2026) joined with the complete GeBIZ award archive FY2021-2026: registrations with workhead, grade and expiry, each carrying the firm's GeBIZ award count, total awarded value and award dates, plus derived analytics.
